quotes: For expected delivery before Dec. 25, the Postal Service advises customers to send mail and packages by the following dates:
2026 Holiday Shipping Dates for Contiguous U.S. (Lower 48 States) - USPS Ground Advantage service: Dec. 17 - First-Class Mail: Dec. 17 - Priority Mail: Dec. 18 - Priority Mail Express: Dec. 19
2026 Holiday Shipping Dates for Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and U.S. Territories - USPS Ground Advantage service: Dec. 16
customers should always plan to mail and ship packages early to ensure arrival by Dec. 25

2026 Holiday Season Recommended Last Days to Ship for Dec. 24 Delivery - U.S. DOMESTIC: UPS Ground | Check ups.com/ctc for details; UPS 3 Day Select | Dec. 21; UPS 2nd Day Air | Dec. 22; UPS Next Day Air | Dec. 23
Shipments to certain destinations may require an earlier ship date. Check ups.com/ctc
Thursday Nov. 26 Thanksgiving Day (UPS Holiday) No UPS pickup or delivery service.
Friday Dec. 25 Christmas Day (UPS Holiday) No UPS pickup or delivery service.
The information below provides the last shipping dates for select services to help ensure your package is scheduled to arrive by December 24, 2026. These dates are subject to change.

FedEx Ground / Home Delivery table: 5 day transit column = Thur. 12/17; 4 day transit = Fri. 12/18; 3 day transit = Mon. 12/21; 2 day transit = Tue. 12/22; 1 day transit = Wed. 12/23 (verified by vision read of official PDF page 1, 2026-11-03)

FedEx 2Day & 2Day AM = 12/22; First/Priority/Standard Overnight + Extra Hours = 12/23; Express Saver = 12/21; SameDay = 12/24; Ground Economy = 12/15 (verified by vision read of official PDF page 1, 2026-11-03)

FedEx Ground and FedEx Home Delivery: Delivery times vary based on origin and destination. The last day to ship is based on a regular scheduled pickup or drop off of shipments at a staffed FedEx location. Transit times are typically 1 to 5 business days.
FedEx holiday landing page links the 2026 Peak Last Day to Ship PDF as the authoritative deadline source; these dates are subject to change.

scope_rules.rule: Never present deadline dates as guarantees - USPS calls them 'recommended', UPS 'recommended last days', FedEx 'subject to change'. Always write 'recommended send-by' or 'last day to ship for Dec 24/25 arrival', and note dates can shift / certain destinations need earlier ship dates.
UPS Ground has NO published flat cutoff - copy must say 'check ups.com/ctc' or 'varies by lane' rather than inventing a Ground date.
scope_rules.reason: UPS table explicitly defers Ground to ups.com/ctc

scope_rules.rule: FedEx Ground dates are transit-day-dependent, not one date - copy must tie each date to a transit-time lane (5-day = Dec 17 ... 1-day = Dec 23), never state 'FedEx Ground deadline is X' flat.
scope_rules.reason: PDF structure is a transit matrix

scope_rules.rule: Deadlines apply to lower-48/contiguous U.S. domestic lanes; AK/HI/PR/international differ - qualify or use the AK/HI/territories numbers if mentioned.
